tree-planting-festival.x: The Tree Planting Festival is the second celebration of the year and takes place on the 21st of every [[spring|Spring]]. The [[festival|festival]] meet up is available from 8am to 2pm and is triggered by entering the area near the [[ranch|ranch]]. The player is notified by mail from the [[connor|Mayor]] delivered on the 20th of Spring of the upcoming event, the letter would be:

During the first year, [[quest|Tree Planting Festival I side quest]] will be initiated on the beginning of the day. Subsequently, it can be initiated by starting the main activity once the previous side quest is completed.

Once you start the festival, the [[townies|townies]] and the [[player|Player]] walk into the Caverns and travel by boat to [[purwo-woods|Purwo Woods]]. Initially, Purwo Woods is barren and only contains stumps in the dirt. Over 3 years of attending the festival, the player and the townies restore the area to a lush forest. Completing the tree planting activity will earn 150 or and a [[banana-seedling|Banana seedling]] as part of the side quest completion, and can only be done up to three times. You also get to keep whatever you've cleaned and dug up.

There is one festival booth shop in the upper side of the island. The first stage of activities will drain some of your [[energy|energy]], so if you have arrived fatigued, make sure to buy and consume some [[candied-tree-seed|Candied tree seed]]s
Unlike other festivals, the main activity of Tree Planting Festival can only be done 3 times. Subsequently there will be no activity and there is also no merit points awarded for attendance.
The main event of the festival is the tree planting activity. To trigger it, talk to Connor.

Your inventory will temporarily be replaced with your [[axe|axe]], [[scythe|scythe]] for stage A, and [[hoe|hoe]] for stage B. Any excessive items obtained throughout the festival will be mailed by Connor. However, to avoid buggy experience it is recommended to only bring those 3 when attending the festival.
The tree planting is completed in 3 stages

i: Stage A: Clear the debris in this area to move on to the next stage. · This stage does not drains your [[energy|energy]].
Stage B: Till a 2x2 spot on all of the marked ground you come across to move onto the next stage. · This stage does not drain your [[energy|energy]].
Stage C: Find the tilled areas in the stage and plant you allotted sapling to finish the tree planting festival! · This stage does not drain your [[energy|energy]].

tree-planting-festival.x: Completing the activity will also earn 70 [[friendship|friendship points]] with all [[townies|townies]].
The festival ends at 9pm with the player standing in front of their [[farmhouse|Farmhouse]].

beach-cleanup-day.x: Beach Cleanup Day is a [[festival|festival]] on the 27th day of [[summer|Summer]]. Upon waking up on the 27th, the player is prompted with the in game text, 'There's a festival running today, consider checking it out...' To initiate the festival, proceed to beach between 09:00 and 13:00. On Summer 26th the player will receive a letter from the [[connor|mayor]]:
Once the festival begins, the in-game clock will stop and the player will be free to socialize with any townies and participate in any activities as much as they like.

The main event of the festival is a cutscene of the Townies' efforts to clean up the beach. There is also a shop that sells items and optional games. To initiate the main event, interact with the main event monument centrally located on the beach.
The festival ends when player leaves the area and returns player home at 21:00. Attending the festival (even though skipping main event) will earn 40 or.
There are two festival shops, one by the [[beach-shack|Beach Shack]] and one at the Pufferfish booth.
The shop near the Beach Shack includes batteries and kelp sold at reduced prices:

At the Pufferfish shop, the player can purchase Pufferfish clothing and furniture from [[raina|Raina]]. These items are also available [[sturdy-computer|online]] at the [[pufferfish-shop|Pufferfish Shop]].
The player can initiate a game of tug of war at the "Tug of War Registration Booth" located at the water's edge. Strength of tug of war team is based on player's max stamina.

r: First place at Tug of War
Second place at Tug of War

beach-cleanup-day.x: The player can also initiate a swimming contest at the lower left hand area of the beach. The game uses the player's stamina and swimming is performed by alternating between the 'Q' and 'R' keys.
1st place - Sunny (10.62s), 2nd place - Chaem (10.62s), 3rd place - Zarah (11.85s), 4th place - Surya (12.84s)

cherry-blossom-potluck.x: The Cherry Blossom Potluck is the first festival of the year, taking place on the 10th of [[spring|Spring]] at [[alun-alun-square|Alun-Alun Square]], on the east side of the [[lake|Lake]]. The celebration begins by interacting with the festival orb in the square between 9:00 - 14:00. On Spring 9th the player will receive a letter:
Once the festival begins, the in-game clock will stop and the player will be free to socialize with any townies and participate in any activities as much as they like.

The player can contribute to the potluck with an ingredient of their choice by putting it into the pot on the east of the festival. Talking to [[connor|Connor]], whether contributing or not, will progress the main event: a taste testing by [[judge-ross|Judge Ross]].
Players can also take part in a sack race-like minigame, Balap Karung, located south-west of the festival.
There is also a small shop stall located north of the festival where a couple of outdoor decorations can be purchased.
Leaving the festival location will bring it to an end, with the player spawning in front of their house at 21:00. Attending the festival (even though skipping main event) will earn 40 or.
Shop

The Cherry Blossom Booth offers a selection of items for purchase - one is [[ancient-patterned-vase|ancient patterned vase]] that is exclusive to the festival and nine [[furniture-store|Furniture Store]] items sold at a 20% discount.
Hotpot Donation

The main event of the festival hinges on the item the player donates to the hotpot. There are six possible results depending on the item donated - if one is donated at all - and its quality, with different amounts of points afforded to them. The amount of points earned affects the success of the potluck and the responses of the townies afterwards. After the soup tasting, the festival ends, so make sure you've done all you want before starting the main event. Only loved hotpot is considered as winning the festival, and earning 300 or as well as points Heart.
Any item not specifically listed is judged by its [[gift-preferences|gifting category]].

Note: Not all listed items may be obtainable by normal gameplay. Due to changes in how wine is made, only Apple wine is treated as a specified ingredient. All other wines are considered Artisan products, and will only receive a neutral score.
Love
[[judge-ross|Judge Ross]]: Wow... This soup tastes AMAZING! All of you have made a masterpiece! Great job, Starlet Town!A Loved hotpot is worth 80 points.

cherry-blossom-potluck.x: Balap Karung

Interacting with the Registration sign on the south side of the lake allows the player to play the Balap Karung minigame. In addition to participating in the race, the player can view instructions on how to play and try a practice run.

Balap Karung is a timing game where players must press an interact button - space or A - when a moving indicator is in the center green section of a slider bar. The closer the indicator is to the center of the bar when tapped, the further the player will jump. With every success, the indicator moves faster and a little stamina is drained. When stamina is drained completely or the player taps outside of the green section, they will trip and lose time in the race. Eating [[buff|extra stamina food]] is recommended.
Balap Karung rewards:

animal-festival.x: Animal Festival is a [[festival|festival]] on the 12th day of [[summer|Summer]]. Upon waking up on the 12th, the player is prompted with the in game text, 'There's a festival running today, consider checking it out...'
To initiate festival, proceed to [[starlet-town|Starlet Town]] in front of the [[community-center|Community Center]] between 09:00 and 14:00. On Summer 5th the player will receive a letter:
And one day before the festival begins, the player will receive another letter:

The festival ends when player leaves the area and returns player home at 21:00. This festival is about celebrating the animals on Coral Island, and includes several animal themed games. There is also a shop that sells items. Attending the festival (even though skipping main event) will earn 40 or.
There is one festival shop near the Museum's entrance. The Baroque bushes, hay and Chicken suit are sold at a 20% discount. The rest are only being sold at this booth.

The Main event for the festival. The Pet Race involves racing different [[townies|Townies]] and their pets. The player must run through an obstacle course through to the checkered finish line while avoiding getting their pet stuck or lost. If the pet stops following the player, they must go back to retrieve them. Pets with higher hearts will move faster and are better able to catch up to their owner. The best racer of 3 rounds wins the competition.

r: Indoor pet bed fox theme, 300 or

animal-festival.x: There is a Cow Competition in front of the Community Center that involves racing different [[townies|Townie's]] cows against each other. They will be distracted by food on the ground, and the player calls them back to task by pressing a set of keys. Cows with higher health will move faster between distractions. The best cow of 3 rounds wins the competition.

The Chicken Competition is located south of the community center. The player's chicken has a staring contest with other chickens and the best of 3 rounds wins the competition. Pressing the right keys on time will recoup some health points for the player's chicken. Chickens with higher hearts will start with higher health points. Winning the competition is one of the requirements for a chicken to be able to lay [[golden-egg|golden egg]]s.

The Rodeo is south of the Chicken Competition, and the challenge is to see how long the player can stay mounted on the mechanical bull. If they miss entering the right keys three times, they're thrown off.

The Rodeo features a leaderboard with three Townies leading the ranking. Chaem holds first place with a record of 75.00s, Noah holds second place with 50.00s and Mark is in last place at 25.00s. If the player beats one of these times, the leaderboard order changes.

harvest-festival.x: The Harvest Festival is the first festival of Fall, taking place on the 15th at [[alun-alun-square|Alun-Alun Square]], on the east side of the [[lake|Lake]]. The celebration begins by interacting with the festival orb in the square after 19:00. On Fall 5th the player will receive a letter:
In the morning, one day before the festival, the player will receive:

Once the festival begins, the in-game clock will stop and the player will be free to socialize with any townies and participate in any activities as much as they like. Players can earn [[merit-points|Merit Points]] for attending the festival and participating in the various minigames. Players will earn a minimum of 40 or for attending the festival, even if they do not participate in the Harvest Display Contest.
Leaving the festival location will bring it to an end, with the player spawning in front of their house at 23:50.
Shop
There is a Harvest Festival Booth at the top of the map, adjacent to the [[pufferfish-drilling-corp|Pufferfish]] booth. Several items (including fertilizer and seeds) are sold at discounted prices.
The Harvest Festival Booth stocks:
In the future, it will be possible to receive a free item from the Moon Cake booth, and propaganda from the Pufferfish booth.
Harvest Display Contest

The player can participate in the Harvest Display contest by placing their farm items in the empty crates at the far right of Alun-Alun Square. The items are not automatically returned at the end of the festival, and the player should remember to collect them before leaving. Players can retrieve their items after the contest by going to the display and selecting "Submit Items" and placing the items back into their [[inventory|Inventory]].

The player's Harvest Display is judged by the number of categories the collection of items include, each items' base price, and each items' quality which are all added together to determine the player's final score. This score is then compared to a rival farmer's score for their own display to determine a winner and which prizes they earn. Winning the Harvest Display Contest will earn the player 300 or.
Scoring
Categories
The Display Contest recognizes the six categories mentioned in the Fall 5th invitation letter:
Including items from the different categories awards Diversity Points. Every category represented in the display awards 6 points each, for a maximum of 36 points.
Sell Price and Quality

Individual items added to the display are each scored according to their sell price and their quality, from 1 point for a low-value, base quality item to 25 points for an osmium quality item worth at least 400 . The sell price used for judging refers to the price of the specific item at its quality rather than its base price.

If the player displays 400+ value, osmium-quality products for each of the six categories, the maximum amount of points earned for the competition is 186. Prior to the 1.1 update, the maximum possible score was 181, as there were no available vegetables worth 400+ (with the most valuable vegetable being [[cauliflower|Cauliflower]]). In the current version of the game, using an osmium quality [[bluecole|Bluecole]] for the vegetable category, and any osmium quality products worth 400+ for the remaining five categories, is the only way to obtain the maximum score of 186.

Note: There is a meter in-game during the festival that displays how many points your display is worth. After you submit your items the 'Competition Reward' meter will show your total display points below in a blue bubble. If unsure, bring all your best items to the event and experiment with arrangements to get the highest score.
Rival Display

As part of the competition element of the Harvest Display, the player is pitted against a rival - [[bobby|Bobby]], a farmer from Beluga Bay. Every year, Bobby will bring a selection of produce from his own farm to be scored against the same criteria as the player's with the highest scoring farmer being declared the winner.

Bobby's display items are chosen each year at the start of the festival from one of the following sets. Which set is determined by the in-game year, with his highest scoring sets appearing at year three and remaining there for the rest of the game.
Year 1
Year 2
Year 3 Onward
Rewards
The rewards for winning the Harvest Display Contest are dependent on the player's score. Winning the harvest display will earn 300 or.
Side Activities
Smashing Pumpkin

The player can also initiate a game of Smashing Pumpkin at the registration desk near the [[lake|Lake]], left of the Alun-Alun Square sign. The goal of this game is to smash as many [[pumpkin|pumpkins]] as possible for the maximum amount of points before time runs out. Smashing multiple pumpkins in a row can create combos. Rotten pumpkins should be avoided, as they reduce the player's points and break combos.

There are three competing Townies. Archie holds first place with a score of 200 points, [[surya|Surya]] holds second place with a score of 150, and [[frank|Frank]] holds last place with 100 points. If the player beats one of these times, the leaderboard order changes. Winning the minigram will earn the player 100 or.
Apple Bobbing

The player can initiate a game of Apple Bobbing at the large washtub to the left of the giant chicken. The goal is to eat as many [[apple|apples]] as possible, avoiding rotten apples and their stunning effects. Winning the minigame will earn the player 100 or.
There are three competing Townies ([[archie|Archie]], [[zoe|Zoe]], [[alice|Alice]]) and their scores will vary between games.

new-year-eve-feast.x: The New Year's Eve Feast is the last festival of Winter, taking place on the 28th at the [[hillside-brewery-and-vineyard|Hillside Brewery and Vineyard]]. The celebration begins by interacting with the festival orb by the grapes after 19:00. On Winter 27th the player will receive a letter:
Once the festival begins, the in-game clock will stop and the player will be free to socialize with any townies and participate in any activities as much as they like.
Leaving the festival location will bring it to an end, with the player spawning in front of their house at 23:50.

There is a New Year Festival Booth at the top of the map, adjacent to the Don't Drop Balloon game. All items are sold at discounted prices except the wine, which has been marked up. There appears to be no limit to how many times each item can be purchased.
The New Year Festival Booth stocks:

The night ends with the start of the main event, which can be triggered by interacting with the festival orb to the middle-right of the event area, near the Lucky Wheel. When the night is over the town gathers by the Observatory to watch fireworks over the Hot Spring.
The player spins a wheel to receive a prize. This wheel is near the middle of the event's area, and can be spun three times per event. Prizes for the wheel are:

The player can initiate a game of Don't Drop Balloon near the top of the area, by the Observatory. The game is played by running up to balloons as they fall and left-clicking them before they touch the ground. The player takes turns with an opponent to push the balloon back up, and the first one to lose all their balloons loses. When needed, the player can press Space for bursts of speed to reach falling balloons in time, but these boosts are temporary. The area below the balloon is indicated with an outline on the ground that changes colors as the balloon lowers.

spooky-day-festival.x: Spooky Day Festival is a [[festival|festival]] on the 28th day of [[fall|Fall]]. To initiate the festival, proceed to the central town square between 19:00 and 22:00. On Fall 27th the player will receive a letter:
Once the festival begins, the in-game clock will stop and the player will be free to socialize with any townies and participate in any activities as much as they like.
The festival ends when player leaves the area and returns player home at 23:50. Attending the festival (even though skipping main event) will earn 40 or.
There is one shop located to the South. All items, not including the scarecrows that are not sold elsewhere, are sold at a 20% discount.

To trigger the Ogoh Ogoh Parade, player can simply interact with the ogoh-ogoh statue in front of Welcome to Starlet Town sign. The night will end by all the townfolks gather watching the children carrying ogoh-ogoh around the area and ended up with fireworks.

There are 3 rounds, 20 seconds each, increasing the amount of graves each round. The player must bonk the lightbulb skeletons and avoid the candle ones. Red lightbulbs are worth +10 points, blue lightbulbs are worth +20 points, and yellow lightbulbs are worth +40 points. Candles are worth -10 points. Some skeleton heads cycle between lightbulbs of various colors and candles so for those skeleton heads, the timing of when the player hits the skeleton head matters.

There are three competing Townies. Archie holds first place with a score of 400 points, Chaem holds second place with a score of 330, and Oliver holds last place with 250 points. If the player beats or matches one of these scores, the leaderboard order changes.

winter-fair.x: The Winter Festival or Winter Fair is the first and longest festival of Winter. It takes place from the 17th to the 21st at the Beach on lower side of [[starlet-town|Starlet Town]]. This festival is the only one that doesn't have a festival orb, and the in-game time will not stop. On Winter 16th the player will receive a letter from [[connor|Mayor]]:

The player can move freely throughout the map because this festival is not locked to a specific location. On the day of the festival, the beach will be filled with docks and ships, along with side activities and games. The also can be seen to attend the festival at evening until late. The festival pamphlet will be visible at 5 PM, but all activities are accessible since morning.
Shop
There are four shops, one is Ben Shop and the other one is Winter Fair Shop. The Winter Shop has 3 categories.
Caravan's Florist and Rare Finds

Ben's Shop is located beside the [[beach-shack|Beach Shack]], the shop is open from 05:00 PM to 11:50 PM. The shop sells random items that have been available since the Winter 1. The selection of items on the first day of the festival will be the same as the selection in Ben's regular shop from the weekend before. Items will restock the next festival day but the selection will not change until Winter 20 (the next weekend).
